title: Capriccio for Piano

music.notes: Seven rounds of MIDI edits (21 to 27). The recording is a hard-limited MP3 with 0.6 s added before the first note.

parts.name: I
parts.story: The White Key warms up with jumps and a stroll, juggles flowers, rests, shimmers with gold sparkles and walks to where the chase finds him.

parts.name: I → II
parts.story: The Black Key sneaks in and chases him off; his aura turns the stage cocoa.

parts.name: II
parts.story: The Black Key alone: fuming, a tantrum, sulking, marching, leaping, asleep, woken by a loud chord.

parts.name: II → III
parts.story: Woken, he stands up grumpy; a piano falls on him at 1:18.6, glows and bursts open at 1:20, and the stage turns petrol.

parts.name: III
parts.story: The White Key bursts out of the piano and dances, spins, jumps, bows.

parts.name: III → Coda
parts.story: The notes turn from blocks into stars; then the stage fades to dusk in 0.7 s and the vanish line widens to make room for three characters.

parts.name: Coda
parts.story: The Black Key floats down friendly, the Brown Piano tiptoes in, all three hug.

characters.name: White Key
characters.look: A cream rectangular card with a lilac edge on the left, a small black beret, black dot eyes, orange cheeks, a small smile, thin black arms and legs, peach mitten hands, a thin black stroke all the way round.

characters.name: Black Key
characters.look: A black body, a pink beret with a green line, a green strip down one side, white eyes, green cheeks, pink arms and legs, black gloves and shoes.

characters.name: Brown Piano
characters.look: A small upright piano with a face: rosy cheeks, keys for teeth, little yellow feet.

moments.what: Juggles flowers: a toss on each falling A, a big toss on the chord, the catch, a shy bow.
Tired, a yawn, sits, falls asleep on the floor.
Woken by the loud chord, stands up grumpy, arms crossed.
Looks up, panics, ducks as the piano falls.
The dance, to 1:35.0: a hat-tip, a spin, a moonwalk, rubber legs, jazz hands, a tornado spin, tiptoes, a freeze.
All three hug, a heart above them.

notes: Published as "Capriccio for Piano – Yonatan Setbon". The latest final is etude1_final_43.mp4. Start times are video times in final 43; the III → Coda start is where the notes' crossing begins (the background changes at 1:52.4).
